blocking_findings.title: Report text normalization breaks the original-byte SHA binding
blocking_findings.finding: The launcher reads JSON/MD with Path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") and hashes their original raw file bytes. Universal-newline decoding converts the actual Windows CRLF reports to LF. JSON serialization/compression/base64 transport preserves that altered text; remote .encode() therefore cannot equal the original raw hash. The exact remote assertion is reproduced failing with the existing original report. MD is also changed byte-for-byte. This is an observed artifact-format incompatibility, not a hypothetical fallback requirement.
blocking_findings.observed_exception: AssertionError at exact embedded remote review hash assertion
blocking_findings.impact: For reports in the demonstrated format, the remote request fails before predecessor/resource admission or GPU launch, after the exclusive local attempt has already been created. No automatic retry is implemented. An LF-only report happens to avoid this mismatch, but the operator does not preserve the bytes of the actual reviewed artifacts supplied in this workflow.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Read the exact report bytes and transport them losslessly. For these UTF-8 artifacts, read_bytes().decode("utf-8") preserves CRLF while keeping the existing string payload; keep hashing the same raw bytes for JSON and preserve MD bytes too. No fallback, try/except, or unrelated refactor is needed.
